## Change

Describe the behavior changed and the problem it solves. Link the relevant issue.

## Verification

List the commands run and their results, including any tests not run.

- [ ] Added a regression test for behavior changes.
- [ ] Tests use synthetic data and loopback services only, with no paid model calls.
- [ ] No credentials, private run data, local settings, or generated release evidence are included.
- [ ] Updated documentation and regenerated schemas if contracts changed.
- [ ] Reviewed dependency notices if dependencies changed.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md). Report vulnerabilities privately, not in a pull request.
